title: Kuat Orbital Drydock — Imperial Star Destroyer
description: An immense armoured Imperial wedge suspended in an open orbital drydock. Eight twin heavy batteries flank terraced command decks, a panoramic hammerhead bridge and twin shield generators. Three primary and four secondary engine bells face the stern. Keel cradles, maintenance galleries, a suspended inspection crane and an incoming white-and-red supply corvette tell the story of a capital ship preparing for departure.
